Synthetic alert mails, written by hand to resemble the portals' layouts (tracking links,
photos above titles, several listings per mail). They are NOT real alert mails: once the agent
mailbox receives real ones (spec §9 step 2), add anonymised copies here and tune `src/parse.js`.

Exception: `onthemarket.html` is an anonymised copy of a real OnTheMarket alert from October 2026
(markup as sent; tracking parameters, listing IDs, photos, agents and recipient replaced).
